eligible_inventory.method: Independent complete os.walk inventory; checker SKIP names parsed with ast.literal_eval; ordinary files hashed without importing or executing submissions

limitations: Receipt-backed verification only; neither submissions nor evaluator were imported or executed on the host or rerun.

Case stream byte counts and SHA256 values are structurally checked and sealed through evaluation SHA256; bounded and possibly redacted excerpts cannot independently reconstruct complete streams or report files.

Official SDK root-exit, capture, network-disabled and integrity assertions are recorded receipts, not independent sandbox attestation; permission-profile content and SDK launcher implementation were outside this blind scope.
No receipt reports a timeout; descendant termination is not independently proved, as stated in the execution receipts.
Baseline source and checker identities are bound to the supplied manifests; original workspaces, preregistration and excluded private state were outside scope.
